title: Mitigating Preference Leakage via Strict Estimator Separation for Normative Generative Ranking

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM-as-a-judge pipelines by implementing a strict two-judge framework that uses different model families for supervision and evaluation. This separates the training and assessment loops to measure and mitigate inflated performance estimates caused by models systematically favoring outputs from their own family or training distribution.

Formulating culturally grounded story selection as a within-query graded ranking task. Candidates generated under identical cultural constraints are evaluated by rubric-guided LLM judges to distinguish deep normative cultural enactment from surface-level stereotypes and default dominant norms.
